label: human (Azurite Shores 3v2; no ledger row)
people: [gecko]thebluegecko (34.34; played Cortex though the start script says Armada; west land, base A1-A2, never seen) and [gecko]u6bkep (19.24, Armada; the middle sea, commander on the D4 islet). The user (computer_whisperer) hosted as a spectator and said nothing in chat.
our_side: Three seats, factions Random: t2 (seat 0) Armada at B8 on the WEST land beside both people (the lobby boxes were not honoured), t3 (seat 1) Cortex at G8 and t4 (seat 2) Cortex at H8 on the EAST land, which no enemy could walk to. Players Opus 5.5 effort medium (claude2), side commander Opus 5.5 effort high, hands Jev jev-1.14.0, realtime.
summary: A 3v2 on a map split by a sea: our Armada seat t2 shared the west land with both people while t3/t4 sat on an east land no enemy could walk to. thebluegecko fought t2 on land (Grunt raids, his commander planting turrets in t2's half until it escaped at 974 of 3,700 health at 9:36, Graverobbers on our wrecks, tier-2 Sumos from 14:46, Mammoths from 24:34, about 60 Wasp gunships at 37:53) while u6bkep took the middle sea from 6:00 and grew it to Dreadnoughts (17:17) and two Epochs (26:36-32:00). Our side out-earned them (50 extractors at 28:00, the east seats banking 6-11k for twenty minutes) and twice stood at his door with a large lead (12:55-15:47, 22:30-24:28), but no unit ever saw his factories and every push into the tier-2 door at A2-A3 went in pieces (the commander at 29:00: 122k lost for 40k killed). From 28:55 the Epochs' 2,450 reach killed the Basilisks, took t3's base, drove t2's body into its corner and killed t2's commander (33:45); Mammoths walked into t2's base (36:58), and the Wasps, met by no anti-air until 38:42, killed the last two commanders at 39:41-39:42.

root.what: The first big lead in his half was spent on his outer spots and not on his base: go_north (12:55) took B4 and A4 (13:26-15:18) as the plan ordered, his tier 2 came out at A3-A4 (advanced constructor 14:22, Sumos 14:46) and at 15:47 the body stepped back to spot_35 on the packet's 'outweighs it' clause, with his labs at A1-A3 never seen. From there the west front was tier 1 against tier 2 behind turrets (Sumos, then Mammoths), and the second lead (22:30) failed at the same door. Reader's reading; no person commented.

bears_on.note: Two leads at his door (12:55-15:47, 22:30-24:28) not used on his base; his tier 2 and then his Mammoths came on.
Every push into the Sumos and the A2 door arrived in pieces (the commander's 27:00 and 29:00 notes).
t2 kept massing tier 1 (200 Maces, 165 Janus, 123 Rocketeers) into Sumos and Mammoths; its advanced lab came only at 17:59.
His commander at 974 of 3,700 health in our half at 9:36 escaped; here commander death was per ally team (t2 played on after 33:45), so a kill would have cost him his commander, not the game.
Both halves: the A2 door attacked three times instead of going round, and no anti-air until 54-60 Wasps had arrived; two commanders died 1:48 after the first Wasp.
t4's 98 Goons traded nothing against floating turrets, ships and Exploiters (seat 2 13:42, 17:42).
Scorpions and Twin Guards at C3, B3 and A2 made each tier-1 approach pay; Fatboys (700) were the reach that out-ranged the Mammoths.
From his side: about 20 Graverobbers at B3 from 8:49 (45 killed by 22:30) on the wrecks of our fights in his half.

lens.caveats: No truth file: the opponent's numbers are what we saw (floors), and minutes.py's 'he starts C2/F4/G5' are guesses; his commander was seen at A2 (1131, 1073) at 3:35. The per-match tools read only record-0, so seats 1 and 2 were run through symlinked scratch views of record-1/-2. pro_baseline.py not run (Comet only); impedance_sweep.py not run. No person commented (only our 'gl hf'), no ledger row; the root and every 'because' are the reader's reading or the in-game players' and commander's notes (model readings). The seen trade (all seats, structures included) was 2:1 against from 7:00 (7,975 lost / 3,252 killed to 12:00; 141.9k / 62.1k to 29:00). Process note: this reader's first scratch views overwrote two stale shared links in the scratchpad's seat1/seat2 folders, restored to their 1792547311 targets within a minute.

open_questions: Where were his factories? No unit saw one in 39:42 although units stood 437-650 from A1/A2 at 15:00 and 24:00-26:00; the Finch the commander asked for at 10:50 is not traced here.
Was the root the land door (12:55-15:47, then 24:28) or the sea? The land army was rebuilt to 44.6k by 33:30 after the A2 failures; the Epochs were the loss the side never recovered from.
Was the 15:47 step back the hands' odds reading of seven Sumos against 51 soldiers under the packet's 'outweighs it' clause, and would a commit then have won?
Did the Apocalypse missiles on A2 (34:43) and B1 (37:40) land or meet an anti-nuke? Nothing of ours saw.
Could t3's idle advanced lab (7:00-12:00) or a shipyard have contested the sea while u6bkep had only tier-1 floating turrets?
